replies.author: Pavlo
replies.body:
Hey there, unfortunately, the name "Towers" is already in use, please consider changing the name. :)

As for the map, off to a good start, however there is still a lot of work it could use. The mine is very obviosly world edited (you can see the sphere shape), and the rest of the ground is very flat. Please try add some more elevation. Also custom trees would be nice.

Good luck!
